UNKNOWN_EVENT: Something happened that this app has no message for yet.
VALIDATION_FAILED: Some fields are missing or invalid. Check the form and try again.
REQUEST_MALFORMED: The request could not be read. Refresh the page and try again.
REQUEST_FAILED: The request could not be completed.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
FEATURE_PENDING_CONFIRMATION: This feature is waiting on confirmation from the fund and is not available yet.
AUTH_PASSWORD_CHANGE_SUCCESS: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That email and password do not match. Check both and try again.
AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
AUTH_SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
AUTH_ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED: This account has been switched off. Ask another manager to reactivate it.
AUTH_CURRENT_PASSWORD_WRONG: The current password is not right. Try again.
USER_PASSWORD_RESET_SUCCESS: Password for {name} reset. They have been signed out everywhere.
USER_CANNOT_DEACTIVATE_SELF: You cannot switch off your own account. Ask another manager.
USER_RESET_OWN_PASSWORD: Change your own password from your account, where the current one is checked.
PROGRAM_NAME_TAKEN: A program called {name} already exists. Choose another name.
PROGRAM_PROTECTED: The fund's membership program is protected and can never be removed.
PROGRAM_PROTECTED_SHAPE: The fund's membership program is protected: its type cannot change.
PROGRAM_SHAPE_LOCKED: A program's type can only change before it has payments or cycles. This one has {payments} payments and {cycles} cycles.
PROGRAM_TYPE_LOCKED: A program can only switch between periodic and temporary while no one is enrolled in it: temporary programs keep no pledges. This one has {enrollments} enrollments.
PROGRAM_LIMIT_REACHED: There are already {limit} programs. Remove one before adding another.
PROGRAM_HAS_NO_CYCLES: {name} is a temporary program: it is collected once and has no cycles. Only periodic programs run in cycles.
PROGRAM_NOT_MONTHLY: {name} keeps a dated ledger, not a monthly grid. Record a dated payment instead.
PROGRAM_NOT_DATED: {name} keeps a monthly grid. Enter the payment in its month instead.
CYCLE_ACTIVATE_SUCCESS: Cycle {startYear}–{endYear} is now the current cycle.
CYCLE_SPLIT_NOT_SHORTER: To split a cycle, choose a length shorter than its {lengthYears} years.
CYCLE_CURRENT_DROPS_THIS_YEAR: {year} would no longer be in the current cycle, so no payment for {year} could be recorded. Split the cycle instead, so {year} starts the next one.
CYCLE_LEAVES_GAP: {years} would sit between two cycles and belong to neither, so its payments could never be recorded. Split the cycle instead, or change the next cycle first.
CYCLE_CURRENT_NOT_FOUND: {name} has no current cycle yet. Create one to start recording payments.
CYCLE_YEAR_OUT_OF_RANGE: {year} is outside the current cycle ({startYear}–{endYear}). Pick a year inside it.
CYCLE_OVERLAP: Those years overlap the {startYear}–{endYear} cycle. Choose years no other cycle of this program covers.
CYCLE_RANGE_STRANDS_PAYMENTS: {count} payments fall in years this change would remove from the cycle. Split the cycle instead: those years start the next cycle and keep their payments.
CONTRIBUTOR_ACCOUNT_NUMBER_TAKEN: Account number {accountNumber} already belongs to someone, past or present. Check the number.
CONTRIBUTOR_HAS_ENROLLMENTS: This contributor is still enrolled in: {names}. Remove those enrollments first, or mark them dormant.
CONTRIBUTOR_DUPLICATE_SCAN_SUCCESS: Checked {scanned} contributors. {newFlags} new possible duplicates to review.
CONTRIBUTOR_DUPLICATE_DISMISS_SUCCESS: Marked as different people. This pair will not be raised again.
CONTRIBUTOR_DUPLICATE_MERGE_SUCCESS: Merged. {movedEnrollments} enrollments moved to the record you kept.
CONTRIBUTOR_SCAN_TOO_LARGE: There are more than {limit} contributors, too many to compare at once.
DUPLICATE_FLAG_NOT_FOUND: That possible duplicate does not exist.
DUPLICATE_FLAG_ALREADY_RESOLVED: Someone has already decided this one. Refresh the list.
DUPLICATE_MERGE_KEEP_INVALID: Choose one of the two records to keep.
DUPLICATE_CONTRIBUTOR_GONE: One of these records was removed or merged since this was raised. Refresh the list.
CONTRIBUTOR_MERGE_CONFLICT: Both records are enrolled in: {names}. Remove or correct one of those enrollments first, then merge.
ENROLLMENT_MARK_DORMANT_SUCCESS: {contributorName} is now dormant in this program.
ENROLLMENT_NOT_FOUND: That contributor is not enrolled in this program.
ENROLLMENT_EXISTS: This contributor is already enrolled in {programName}.
ENROLLMENT_HAS_PAYMENTS: This contributor has {count} payments in this program, so the enrollment cannot be removed. Mark it dormant instead.
ENROLLMENT_PROGRAM_TEMPORARY: {programName} is a temporary program: people give to it without enrolling, and it keeps no pledge or previous subscription. Record their payment instead.
PAYMENT_SELF_TRANSFER: A program cannot pay itself. Choose another paying program.
PAYMENT_PAYER_PROGRAM_NOT_FOUND: The paying program does not exist.
PAYMENT_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This form was already used for another program. Reopen it and try again.
